viewing_check: Wind it and check it runs, strikes, repeats when the top button is pressed, and the alarm sounds. Look at the lower back plate for a maker stamp (Drocourt, Margaine, Lerolle, Jacot, Couaillet) or serial: a good maker lifts it well past A$700. Check dial for hairline cracks and glasses for chips.
